content: निवापः .²1 Seed, grain, seed-corn. .²2 An offering to the manes of deceased parents or other relatives, a libation of water <ab>&c.</ab> at the Śrāddha ceremony; एको निवापसलिलं पिबसीत्ययुक्तम् <ls>Māl. 9. 40</ls>; निवापदत्तिभिः <ls>R. 8. 86</ls>; निवापञ्जलयः पितॄणाम् <ls n="R.">5. 8</ls>, <ls n="R.">15. 91</ls>; <ls>Mu. 4. 5</ls>. .²3 A gift or offering in general.
